title: Areas Related to Circles: Sectors and Segments
seo_title: Areas Related to Circles Class 10 Worksheet with Answers (NCERT Chapter 11)
standard_code: Class 10, Chapter 11: Areas Related to Circles
standard_text: Area of sectors and segments of a circle; problems based on areas and perimeter / circumference of the above said plane figures; in calculating the area of a segment of a circle, problems are restricted to central angles of 60° and 90° only (summary of the CBSE syllabus)
meta_desc: Class 10 Areas Related to Circles worksheet (NCERT Chapter 11): circumference and area, arc length, area of a sector, segments for 60° and 90°, and problems. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Arc length = θ/360° × 2πr. Segment = sector − triangle.
body_html:
How it works

A sector is the part of a circle between two radii. For angle θ: area = θ/360° × πr², arc length = θ/360° × 2πr.

A segment is the part between a chord and its arc. Minor segment = sector − triangle. For 90° the triangle is ½r²; for 60° it is equilateral with area (√3/4)r².

Major sector = πr² − minor sector. Use π = 22/7 when the radius is a multiple of 7.

Example

Find the area of a sector of angle 60° in a circle of radius 21 cm.

60/360 × 22/7 × 21²

⅙ × 1,386

Answer: 231 cm²

Example

Find the area of the minor segment for a 90° chord in a circle of radius 10 cm (π = 3.14).

Sector = ¼ × 3.14 × 100 = 78.5

Triangle = ½ × 10 × 10 = 50

Answer: 28.5 cm²

Common mistakes

  • Using 2πr for the area of a sector. Area uses πr², arc length uses 2πr.
  • Using θ/180 instead of θ/360.
  • Forgetting the two radii when finding the perimeter of a sector: perimeter = arc + 2r.

faq.q: What is the formula for the area of a sector?
faq.a: Area of a sector of angle θ = θ/360° × πr².

faq.q: What is the formula for the length of an arc?
faq.a: Length of the arc of a sector of angle θ = θ/360° × 2πr.

faq.q: How do I find the area of a segment of a circle?
faq.a: Area of the minor segment = area of the sector − area of the triangle formed by the two radii and the chord.

faq.q: What is the difference between a sector and a segment?
faq.a: A sector is bounded by two radii and an arc; a segment is bounded by a chord and an arc.
